reason: The hypothesis makes multiple specific claims about film formation, preferential removal at phase boundaries, micro-galvanic coupling, and synergistic degradation, but no prior evidence is cited to support any of these premises.
premises: Protective oxide/passive layers form on the alloy phases
Wear mechanically removes these protective films preferentially at phase boundaries
Exposed interphase regions are more corrosion-susceptible and form micro-galvanic couples
Elevated temperature accelerates oxidation kinetics and weakens interphase interfaces
Combined wear and corrosion produces a synergistic effect greater than the sum of individual effects
